content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Laboratory
content_sections.text: The post is in the KVAFSU-CVA Rabies Diagnostic Laboratory, which the notice describes as a WOAH Reference Laboratory for Rabies. The laboratory is part of the Department of Veterinary Microbiology, Veterinary College, Hebbal, Bengaluru, under Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries Sciences University, Bidar. The notification is signed by the Regional Coordinator and the Dean, Veterinary College, Hebbal, Bengaluru - 560 024.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's Degree in Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Science / Fisheries Sciences Rabies diagnosis and surveillance Experience in Molecular Biology & Cell Culture Molecular techniques (Isolation of nucleic acids, PCR, Real Time PCR and downstream applications) Laboratory management including maintenance of records, Documentation, Preparation of reports, management of store operations, Computer Skills, Experience in preparation of IEC materials The candidate's age must be less than 35 years. The notice does not mention a date on which age is counted or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Young Professional II post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Young Professional II is engaged on consolidated basis under the revolving fund of the laboratory, with consolidated emoluments of Rs. 25,000/-. The notice does not mention the length of the engagement. It states that the appointment is terminable at any time without assigning any reason, and that the candidate has no right for any permanent employment in the University. The selected candidate should be prepared to join immediately and turn out satisfactory work as assigned.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KVAFSU Young Professional II
content_sections.text: The application has two parts: a soft copy sent by email before the deadline, and a filled-in form carried to the interview. Fill in the application form given in Annexure-1 of the notification. Email the soft copy of the application to [email protected] latest by 28 November 2026. On the interview day, bring the duly filled in application form with the necessary enclosures and recent passport size photographs, as given in Annexure-1. Bring the original certificates for verification at the time of the interview. Duly filled in application form (Annexure-1) Necessary enclosures Recent passport size photographs Original certificates, for verification at the interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates should appear for an interview in the chamber of the Dean (Vety), Veterinary College, KVAFSU, Hebbal, Bengaluru-24 on 3 December 2026 at 12:00 PM. Candidates attend the interview at their own cost. Original certificates are verified at the interview.
